      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removes Boost.Test from CMake, depends, vcpkg, and Guix build configurations, eliminating an external build dependency. As the author notes, 'Replacing Boost.Test as a runner helps us simplify depends and guix' while eliminating dependency-specific platform workarounds such as undersized signal stacks."
    },

      "name": "ipc",

    },

      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp with mechanical header changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical test adjustments in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp follow the framework migration without affecting kernel APIs or boundaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements a custom in-tree test runner in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and updates the test suite runner in src/test/main.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces the external Boost.Test library with an in-tree runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. This addresses longstanding test framework goals (RFC #34666 and issue #8670), improves test assertion failure logging through expression decomposition, avoids library quirks such as undersized signal stacks (#36045), and unblocks future test concurrency."
    },

      "name": "tools",

      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Build and release scripts under contrib/guix belong to the build category rather than tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
